issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עַל הָאָבְנָיִם' means 'on the potter's wheels' (dual of 'אָבְנַיִם', a pair of wheels/stones used in pottery). The Chinese renders it as 'on the stone' (石頭上), which is a mistranslation—it should be 'on the wheels' or 'on the potter's wheel(s)'. This changes the specific object/place of the work.
